payload.security_statement: 'Accepted' means: clears all thermal/voltage/slack-limit violations in the post-crisis AC steady state (single snapshot). AC N-1 re-checked for the top 3 accepted candidate(s) (single branch outages). Not checked: dynamic/transient stability, protection settings, ramp rates, reactive reserve adequacy beyond generator Q limits, time coupling. Not an operational instruction.
assumptions: Network converted from MATPOWER with pandapower.converter.from_ppc (f_hz=60).
Generator active-power setpoints are the Pg values stored in the case file (an operating point, not an optimised dispatch).
Branch loading = max(|S_from|, |S_to|) / rateA (MVA), MATPOWER convention; rateA == 0 is treated as unlimited.
Bus voltage limits are the VMIN/VMAX columns of the case file.

Pre-crisis operating point = pandapower AC-OPF dispatch of the uncontingented case (objective 97435.63 EUR/h, generator P and V setpoints); the case file Pg/Vg are not used. OPF branch limits tightened to 100/VMAX % of current rating so the MVA rating holds.
Single-slack balancing: the slack generator absorbs all imbalance and loss changes.
Load shedding reduces P and Q proportionally (constant power factor).

Amounts are the smallest AC-bisected scale (to the configured resolution) that clears the original violations with originally overloaded branches at or below 99.5 % loading; post-action loadings close to that are expected.
